item.title: [CBS Sports] Dodgers' Kyle Tucker: Continues power surge
item.dc:creator: RotoWire Staff
item.description: Tucker went 2-for-3 with a solo home run, a walk and a second run scored in Friday's 8-2 win over the Giants. Tucker has gone 14-for-32 (.438) with five homers and 11 RBI over his last nine contests. The outfielder has largely struggled this season, but he's rounding into form just in time for the postseason. Tucker is batting .234 with a .728 OPS, 17 homers, 70 RBI, 87 runs scored, 23 doubles, four triples and 11 stolen bases across 146 contests.
item.content:encoded:
Tucker went 2-for-3 with a solo home run, a walk and a second run scored in Friday's 8-2 win over the Giants.
Tucker has gone 14-for-32 (.438) with five homers and 11 RBI over his last nine contests. The outfielder has largely struggled this season, but he's rounding into form just in time for the postseason. Tucker is batting .234 with a .728 OPS, 17 homers, 70 RBI, 87 runs scored, 23 doubles, four triples and 11 stolen bases across 146 contests.
